name: Circadia
source:
Hiroki Katayama is your average high school kid. He moved to the undersea city Blue Genesis because of his foster dad, his uncle Shigeru's, job. 
Right after he got there, he could tell this place wasn't exactly normal. There were all these rumors, like ghosts showing up, or people getting attacked by monsters called Nightmares. Everyone acted like it was a joke, but still... 
The night they moved in, some weird creature showed up right in front of him. It called itself Navi and said if they lived together, it could awaken his psychic powers. Navi told him there's some huge disaster happening in the real world right now, and if they don't stop it, everything's going down for good. 
It sounded like something that had nothing to do with him, but just like the rumors said, Nightmares really were wandering around Blue Genesis. So even though he didn't want any part of this mess, he started looking for other espers just like Navi told him to.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010813014059/http://www.alvion.co.jp/frame_cirtop.html]the official website[/url]]
translation:
片山弘树是个普通的高中生。由于养育他的叔叔茂的工作，他搬到了海底都市“蓝色创世纪”。
刚到这里，他便察觉到，这座城市似乎并不寻常。幽灵现身，或有人遭到名为“梦魇”的怪物袭击，各种传闻层出不穷。大家嘴上都当作玩笑，可是……
搬来的当晚，一个奇怪的生物出现在他面前。它自称“纳比”，说只要一起生活，就能唤醒弘树的超能力。纳比告诉他，现实世界正发生一场巨大的灾难，若不加以阻止，一切都将彻底毁灭。
这些话听起来仿佛与自己毫无关系，然而，正如传闻所说，梦魇确实徘徊在蓝色创世纪之中。尽管不想卷入这场风波，弘树还是依照纳比的指示，开始寻找其他超能力者。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20010813014059/http://www.alvion.co.jp/frame_cirtop.html]官方网站[/url]]
